style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting. The same art style in every episode. The background is always pure white.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern clothes, Roman armor, comic-book costumes, Japanese or Chinese clothing, nudity, blood

epimetheus.desc_en: Epimetheus, a Titan of Greek myth, a gentle good-natured young man about 25 with soft wavy chestnut-brown hair to the jaw, a short light beard, wide honest eyes and a slightly absent-minded look, Archaic Greek clothing: a knee-length undyed off-white wool chiton belted with a cord, a faded olive-green himation cloak over one shoulder, leather sandals, no armor, no crown

pandora.desc_en: Pandora, the first woman of Greek myth, a young woman about 20 with long dark-brown hair partly tied up with a thin gold band, large curious eyes, Archaic Greek clothing: a long ivory peplos dress with a woven border of small red and dark-blue patterns, a fine pale veil on her shoulders, gold earrings and a thin golden crown of leaves

prometheus.desc_en: Prometheus, a Titan of Greek myth, the elder brother, a lean sharp-eyed man about 35 with short dark-brown hair, a neat dark beard, a keen serious face, Archaic Greek clothing: a knee-length dark-blue wool chiton with a plain cloak, leather sandals, no armor

zeus.desc_en: Zeus, the king of the Greek gods, a tall powerful man about 50 with thick wavy gray-streaked dark hair, a full curly beard, stern eyes, Archaic Greek clothing: a long white chiton with a deep purple himation draped over his left shoulder, a wreath of oak leaves, holding a long scepter, no armor
